The app I use to track my weightlifting is called 'Strong' for the iOS. It's really well designed, gives an enormous amount of statistics, and congratulates you when you complete a workout! Unfortunately it is only free up until your fourth workout. After, it costs $5 (once, it's not a subscription) to get unlimited workouts... Whether or not it's justified is dependent on how you prioritize. For helping me to form habits I use 'Habit List' which is also for the iOS. It's completely free, and gives you stats on each of the habits that you create. Highly recommend if you're trying to get into the habit of working out or running. Strong: http://www.strongapp.me/ Habit List: http://habitlist.com/
